2609.27980.title: Six Layers Less: Encoder Pruning for Whisper with Label-Free Recovery
2609.27980.paper_summary: Pruning large pre-trained transformer-based ASR models such as OpenAI's Whisper has seen great adoption, as pruning the decoder led to significant end-to-end transcription speedups. For instance, the {\tt whisper-large-v3-turbo} variant reduced the decoder from 32 to 4 layers, while Distill-Whisper similarly reduced the decoder to only 2 layers. Although some attention has been put towards reducing the size of the encoder, no approach has seen wide adoption. This could be due to the need for custom inference implementations to take advantage of the compressed model. We present an approach that ranks encoder layers by the leave-one-layer-out change in Word Error Rate (WER). The six layers that cause the least change are removed, corresponding to $18.5\%$ of the encoder stack. The pruned model requires no custom inference code as it is simply a more shallow encoder with fewer layers. We further distill using unlabeled monolingual speech data to recover performance degradation caused by the zero-shot layer pruning. Mean WER across four languages increases to $20.1\%$ after distillation, compared to $21.9\%$ zero-shot, going from a baseline of $18.2\%$. We release all of our code (https://github.com/rasgaard/whisper-encoder-layer-prune) and the pruned model (https://huggingface.co/rasgaard/whisper-large-v3-turbo-encoder-pruned).
2609.27980.paper_summary_zh: 修剪大型預訓練的基於Transformer的自動語音識別（ASR）模型，例如OpenAI的Whisper，已經得到了廣泛的採用，因為修剪解碼器導致了顯著的端到端轉錄速度提升。<lb/>例如，{\tt whisper-large-v3-turbo}變體將解碼器從32層減少到4層，而Distill-Whisper則類似地將解碼器減少到僅2層。<lb/>儘管有一些注意力放在減少編碼器的大小上，但沒有任何方法得到廣泛採用。<lb/>這可能是因為需要自定義推理實現來利用壓縮模型。<lb/>我們提出了一種通過逐層移除變化的詞錯誤率（WER）來對編碼器層進行排名的方法。<lb/>造成最小變化的六層被移除，這相當於編碼器堆疊的$18.5\%$。<lb/>修剪後的模型不需要自定義推理代碼，因為它只是一個層數較少的更淺編碼器。<lb/>我們進一步使用未標記的單語音頻數據進行蒸餾，以恢復由零-shot層修剪引起的性能下降。<lb/>四種語言的平均WER在蒸餾後增加到$20.1\%$，相比之下，零-shot為$21.9\%$，基線為$18.2\%$。<lb/>我們發布了所有代碼（https://github.com/rasgaard/whisper-encoder-layer-prune）和修剪後的模型（https://huggingface.co/rasgaard/whisper-large-v3-turbo-encoder-pruned）。
